'''Crystal''' (Japanese: '''クリスタル''' ''Crystal''), or '''Chris''' (Japanese: '''クリス''' ''Crys'') for short, is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} from [[New Bark Town]], [[Johto]] and one of the main characters of [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]]. She is based on the {{ga|Kris|female player character in Crystal}}.

==History==
Chris first met {{GnB|Gold}} in ''[[GB15|Escape From The Mystery Forest!]]'' when she was stuck in {{p|Suicune}}'s illusory forest while chasing a wild {{p|Dugtrio}}. Since then, they have traveled together. Chris can sometimes act stubborn and childish, which annoyed Gold at first. Despite that, he was able to make friends with her.

==Character==
Chris considers herself an explorer first and a Trainer second, and likes to explore old ruins and mysterious locations. She makes several references to deities, which is a rare occurrence in any Pokémon media. She also seems to believe in superstitions like shooting stars.
